craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. Comma→dash (blinkering held, droplet questioned). Rejected: 'drop' for 'droplet' — droplet is smaller; kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Bliss blinkered here in all three spheres — whose droplet?
to that God, the bliss-sea, I lower my head.
l4.sanskrit_cite: trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram

reads_against.argmap: Whatever bliss at all is seen here even in three worlds. → All seen bliss is a drop of the bliss-ocean god.
